messages:
Tara (presales): Quick: Skylark wants a 2-week POC — WebSocket streaming + function/tool calls + strict JSON schema output. They also asked about ephemeral tokens, CMEK, and an estimated cost for ~90k requests/day. Who can pick up the tech runbook?
Luis (eng): I can assemble an SDK example. WS is best for server toolcalls. Will include resume token semantics and a small reconnect test.
Mei (solutions): For structured output we recommend server-side JSON schema enforcement + one deterministic reformat retry. We'll provide prompt templates and a tiny eval harness.
Arun (security): CMEK available on Dedicated/Private; Hosted requires procurement review. Need Skylark's KMS vendor, key usage, and SAML IdP metadata. Also send them the security questionnaire link.
Bea (sales-ops): Preliminary pricing ballpark for hosted (~90k/day, avg 150 tokens/request) is $7k-$16k/mo. Dedicated reserved estimate reduces unit cost; can offer a 30-day POC credit. I'll include EU-eu-west uplift and egress assumptions.
Tara (presales): They run in EU and want token rotation examples (client rotates every 15m). Can we provide a tiny token refresh proxy they can host?
Luis (eng): Yes — we'll include a node/python example for refresh endpoint and a Docker image. Recommend TTL 15m and rotate refresh token server-side.
Mei (solutions): Telemetry: include trace_id and session_id in each message. Success criteria: schema pass >=99%, toolcall RTT <300ms p95, session resume works within 30s.
Arun (security): Action: Skylark to return completed questionnaire + SAML metadata + KMS info. I'll follow up via email.
deploy-bot: streaming-handler v2.4 rolled out to eu-west — health checks passing. :white_check_mark:
Tara (presales): Plan: Luis to post WS sample + token proxy by Tue EOD, Mei to post runbook and schema templates, Bea to send pricing + PO options Wed AM, Arun to confirm security checklist with Skylark. I'll schedule a short demo with them after artifacts are ready. :thumbsup:
